title: Incredibly Effective and Clears Out Fruit Flies Fast!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 28, 2026
review: If your kitchen has suddenly been invaded by annoying fruit flies, do yourself a favor and buy this TERRO 4-pack immediately. It is by far the easiest, cleanest, and most effective way to eliminate them without having to mix weird DIY concoctions or leave messy open bowls on your counter.Why these traps are absolutely brilliant:Works Like a Magnet: The liquid bait they use is incredibly effective. Within just a few hours of setting them out near my kitchen sink and fruit bowl, I could already see fruit flies swarming the trap and going inside. Within a couple of days, the entire infestation was completely wiped out.Smart "No-Escape" Design: The apple-shaped traps are designed with tiny funnel entries. The flies crawl right in because they love the scent, but the clever design ensures they can't find their way back out.Discreet and Cute Looking: Unlike ugly sticky fly ribbons or unsightly homemade apple cider vinegar jars, these little red apples blend right into your kitchen decor. They are small, low-profile, and look completely harmless sitting on the counter.Long-Lasting Protection: Each little trap lasts for up to 30 days, and since this comes as a 4-pack, you have more than enough supply to scatter them in multiple problem areas (like near trash cans, houseplants, or recycling bins) or save a couple for the next season.Mess-Free: The liquid stays contained inside the sturdy plastic apple, so you don't have to worry about accidental spills or sticky residue on your countertops.It completely takes the frustration out of dealing with fruit flies. If you want a fast-acting, reliable solution that works exactly as advertised, this TERRO pack is worth every penny. Highly recommended!

title: Mostly effective, and for German roach nymphs
date: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2025
review: These have been somewhat effective. While I have seen less of these pests when I've got this active, I've also seen them literally just hangout on top of the apple. It's like it can see its dead incestuous disgusting family in the goo and it actually takes it as a warning to not proceed. Perhaps I should stop reusing the same trap...Once this stuff runs out, the pests start right back up again. Not as dense as before, but it is noticeable. I'd rather have this than nothing, that's for sure.I wish this came with way more of the liquid. I feel like I have too many apples and not enough liquid. This seller doesn't appear to sell the liquid in bulk, you just have to buy more traps, which is annoying.I also prefer filling it way more than it suggests because if I fill it less, then I have to replace it more frequently. Ergo, providing more of the liquid would be far more useful.This does emit a faint smell, but I've found that it only smells when I'm directly above it.Make sure to tell your guests or family that this thing can spill if you pick it up wrong.I'd ideally rate this maybe 3.5 stars. It works well enough to keep the pests down, but it's not a permanent solution and they don't always fall for the trap.Update: I've changed my mind. Solid 4 stars. I noticed German roach nymphs wading dead in the liquid. I've been keeping these near my sink because that's where the fruit flies hang out. It appears as though the roaches, while trying to get a drink in the sink, find the fruit fly trap and want in. I have a small infestation of roaches in my place, so if they don't fall for one trap, I'm glad they'll fall for another. I don't like having roach traps on my counter due to the chemicals used, so this much-less-poisonous-to-humans trap is a great alternative.

title: Easy to use and pretty effective
date: Reviewed in the United States on April 16, 2026
review: I'd give this a 4.5/5 for how strongly it attracts insects - it's not quite as strong as Aunt Fannie's, but still incredibly effective.
